Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The chapter footer on the first page misspells the chapter title; the title is taken from the guide's section map and contents, not from the footer [A01].
The guide calls the device law new and says fines and criminal penalties may apply as defined by statute, but prints no fine amounts, so none are taught [A02] (verify MO-DIST-D-FINES).
The statute section number for the device law penalties is a citation detail and was not turned into a fact [A02].
Every allowed and banned use was restated in original words without widening or narrowing the guide's list.
